description: Export a dataset in one of 16 formats (json, csv, markdown, jsonl, rag_chunks, langchain_json, llamaindex_json, evaluation, pinecone, qdrant, pgvector, chroma, weaviate, milvus, lancedb, upstash). Provide save_path (absolute) to write the export to a local file — recommended, since exports are often too large to return inline. Without save_path, small exports are returned inline and large ones are rejected with a size note. Get dataset IDs from list_datasets.

dataset_id.description: Dataset ID (UUID). Get IDs from list_datasets.

save_path.description: Absolute local file path to write the export to (recommended)

name: export_dataset
title: Export Dataset
